name: rule-engine-ui
description: Rule-engine console: login over protobuf, rule engine setup, rule group authoring, admin logs (ADR-0026)

scripts.proto: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('src/proto/gen',{recursive:true})" && pbjs -t static-module -w es6 -o src/proto/gen/session.js ../contract/src/main/protobuf/springaimcp/ruleengine/v1/session.proto && pbts -o src/proto/gen/session.d.ts src/proto/gen/session.js
scripts.build: npm run proto && tsc --noEmit && vite build
